en.description:
Bubble-popping, reinvented for your wrist.

WristBubbles is a fast, glowing bubble-shooter built from the ground up for your watch. A grey Rock sits at the center, surrounded by a cluster of colored bubbles. Take aim, fire inward, and burst groups of three or more of the same color. Clear every bubble to win — but miss too many shots and a hazard wave comes firing back at you.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag or spin the Digital Crown to aim your shooter
• Release to fire a bubble inward
• Match 3 or more of the same color to burst them
• Bubbles left floating after a burst fall away
• Clear the whole cluster to beat the level
• Don't let a bubble land outside the ring — or it's game over

FEATURES
• 30 handcrafted levels that ramp from cozy to cutthroat
• Six glossy neon bubble colors to match
• Precision aiming with the Digital Crown or a simple drag
• Hazard waves that keep you honest when you start missing
• Combo celebrations when you chain big clears
• Designed for round watch faces — every pixel made for your wrist
• One-handed, pick-up-and-play sessions that fit a spare 30 seconds

No accounts. No clutter. Just you, a watch face full of bubbles, and one perfect shot at a time.

Pop a few. We dare you to stop.
